ov: وندر أو أعجوبة (الإنجليزية: Wonder) هو فيلم دراما أمريكي للمخرج ستيفن تشبوسكي تم إنتاجه سنة 2017. الفيلم من كتابة جاك ثورن وستيفين كونراد والذين استندوا على الرواية التي تحمل نفس الاسم للكاتب راكيل جراميلو، ومن بطولة الطفل يعقوب تريمبلاي وجوليا روبرتس. تستند القصة أساساً على طفل مصاب بمتلازمة تريتشر كولينز.
plotEn:
August "Auggie" Pullman is a 10-year-old boy living in Brooklyn with his parents, Isabel and Nate, older sister Olivia "Via", and their dog, Daisy. Auggie was born with a rare medical facial deformity, mandibulofacial dysostosis. He has undergone 27 surgeries to help him function and wears an astronaut helmet to hide his face in public. As Auggie approaches fifth grade, his parents decide to stop homeschooling him and enroll him at Beecher Prep, a private middle school. At the start of the school year, he is ostracized and is constantly bullied by classmate Julian Albans and his friends Amos, Miles, and Henry, but Auggie soon forms a close friendship with his classmate Jack Will, whom he met during a tour of the school.
For Halloween, Auggie is forced to reuse his Ghostface costume from the previous year after Daisy ruins his planned Boba Fett costume. On entering his homeroom, he overhears Jack, who does not recognize him (expecting him to be dressed as Boba Fett), joining Julian and his friends in making fun of him behind his back, claiming he was forced to be friends with Auggie and would "kill himself" if he looked like Auggie. Auggie is devastated and becomes sick, forcing Isabel to abandon her mother-daughter day with Via to pick him up. Though she is hurt, Via convinces Auggie to go trick-or-treating with her, as she has been rejected by her own best friend, Miranda.
